content.text:
18 hours ago
ETF tracking Nasdaq-100 outperforms
A popular exchange-traded fund that tracks the technology-heavy Nasdaq-100 index was up in late afternoon trading on Friday, beating the Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite Index.
The Invesco QQQ Trust Series 1, whose five largest holdings as recently as Sept. 16 were Nvidia, Apple, Microsoft, Micron Technology and Amazon.com, was gaining 0.4%.
Micron's stock had the biggest gain among the group, jumping 2.9%, while Amazon's rose a sharp 1.4% and Nvidia's edged up 0.1%, according to FactSet. Shares of Apple and Microsoft were trading down modestly as the U.S. stock market approached the closing bell.
